results.title: Secrets of Mercy Hospital
results.overview: Returning to the working-class town she fled as a teenager, Kendra confronts the long-buried secret of the baby daughter she left behind. Facing pain, guilt and unanswered questions, she searches for healing, forgiveness and a second chance.

results.title: Unstoppable
results.overview: Kaya has always wanted to be just like all the other cells in her part of the body. So, when the others begin preparing for the great quest, and she’s left behind - her heart breaks. Determined to find her own way, Kaya sets off, alone, into the vast and mysterious world of the body. Along the way, she rescues the grumpy but noble General Abel and despite being total opposites, an unlikely friendship begins to bloom. When danger grows from within, Kaya and Abel must work together to protect the body they call home, and Kaya must discover that what sets her apart might just be what makes her truly special.

results.title: 26F Seeking Friend
results.overview: After posting on Reddit looking for a best friend, a lonely, socially awkward woman interviews a series of potential new friends.

results.title: Hearing
results.overview: Ninh lives with his mother and misses his ex-wife Ngoc and their young children. In his work as a mechanic who installs decibel meters in public spaces and homes, Ninh observes the silence that haunts relationships. Wishing for his parents, who live apart and do not speak to each other, to reconcile, his fear of losing connection to his loved ones forces Ninh to face life’s unpredictable rhythms.

results.title: Gamer Warz
results.overview: An audio/video digital media art piece from the expansive mind of Tommy Tallarico, Gamer Warz documents the ongoing conflict of gamers from all walks of life and time periods. Witness the glory of three men, each representing a different tech giant, engaged in a battle of wits to determine who possesses the greatest technology of all.

results.title: Spin Cycle: The Change We Carry
results.original_title: Spin Cycle: The Change We Carry
results.overview: In a bustling Los Angeles strip mall parking lot, Mandy is a well-to-do arrival in a gentrifying neighborhood. She brushes off locals, including the woman panhandling outside the laundromat, Lena. But when a dryer eats the last of her quarters, Mandy goes through literal head changes for fifty cents. Blinded by her own biases, she repeatedly dismisses Lena, who keeps approaching her with a soda cup full of change.

results.title: Guggi
results.overview: An intimate portrait of abstract painter Guggi that traces his journey from humble Irish beginnings—with friends Bono and Gavin Friday—through his post-punk phase and toward international acclaim as an uncompromising artist.

results.title: At Work
results.overview: A successful photographer gives up everything to devote himself to writing and discovers poverty.

results.title: CRIMSON DESIRE
results.overview: In this 1940s romance-turned-thriller short film, a young doctor meets his new patient and is instantly infatuated with her kind heart, stopping at nothing to obtain it.

results.title: Dalam Sujudku
results.overview: Aisyah had a harmonious long-distance marriage until she discovered her husband, Farid, was having an affair. Wounded and devastated, she was faced with the choice of staying or leaving. In the midst of despair, Aisyah turned to God for strength and guidance, though the path to forgiveness and family restoration was not easy.

results.title: NASCAR vs. Navy: The San Diego Mini Movie
results.original_title: NASCAR vs. Navy: The San Diego Mini Movie
results.overview: A group of NASCAR drivers are called to base. Not to prove themselves, but to help the U.S. Navy prepare for the inaugural Race the Base. But when the drivers arrive, they’re met by a squadron of elite hot-shot pilots who aren’t exactly thrilled about their runway being transformed into a race track. To earn the pilots’ respect and ensure the event can move forward, the drivers and sailors go head-to-head in a series of intense yet entertaining challenges. What follows is a cinematic, high-energy, and unexpectedly authentic journey as the drivers immerse themselves in Navy life.

results.title: Quand la nuit tombe
results.overview: Fifteen-year-old Iris finds herself alone at home one evening when her boyfriend, Romain, pays her a surprise visit. What seemed like a tender and romantic evening turns out to be quite the opposite…

results.title: Bee My Love
results.overview: Private chef Hannah Jones, competing for her dream job with a celebrity restaurateur, finds inspiration in her mother’s recipes, the sweetness of honey, and a struggling beekeeper who teaches her to believe that life, and love, are sweetest when shared.

results.title: Cockroaches
results.overview: Three porch pirates steal a van and find the kidnapped Queen of Belgium in the back. Low-rent larceny spirals into a disaster worth remembering and mutual regret might be mistaken for something deeper. Probably not, but maybe.

results.title: Le 55e Festival Interceltique de Lorient - Le Grand Spectacle
results.original_title: Le 55e Festival Interceltique de Lorient - Le Grand Spectacle

results.title: Stormbound
results.overview: An intimate look at Jeff Gammons, a chronically ill man who finds peace and beauty chasing the world's largest hurricanes.

results.title: The Bowens: A Portrait of an American Family
results.original_title: The Bowens: A Portrait of an American Family
results.overview: What does it take to raise an American family today? What kind of values should be instilled into children? Is the future too dangerous, unpredictable and grim? Meet The Bowens - a new kind of American family that decided to take matters into their hands and work together to navigate uncertainties of life through relentless self improvement, strength, discipline, and loyalty.

results.title: Die kleinen und die großen Lügen
results.original_title: Die kleinen und die großen Lügen
results.overview: After a hospital stay following a car accident, entrepreneur Felix returns home. His wife and closest friends are waiting for him there when an unknown woman shows up. Her daughter has disappeared without a trace. Felix wants to help. But his good deed is overshadowed by a suspicion—is there a connection between his accident and the missing girl?

results.title: Girl Dinner
results.overview: After accidentally killing her boyfriend, Jo enlists her best friends, Karla and Rani, to hide the body as long-buried tensions in their friendship begin to surface.

results.title: Deepfaking Sam Altman
results.overview: Director Adam Bhala Lough sets out to better understand the technology and people at the center of the AI boom. His quest sends him on a path towards the father of AI, OpenAI CEO, Sam Altman. When he isn’t able to sit down with Altman himself, Adam travels to India to create an AI version of him to interview instead.
